title: Covariant Dynamical Systems Formulation of the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff Equations
summary: We revisit static, spherically symmetric perfect-fluid stellar models in General Relativity within the framework of the $1+1+2$ semi-tetrad formalism. For locally rotationally symmetric static spacetimes, the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff system can be expressed as a covariant first-order dynamical system and, after suitable normalization, reformulated as a three-dimensional autonomous flow for a general equation of state (EoS).
